summary: Custodial killing vs police version; eye-witness credibility rejected: PW-3/PW-6 failed identification, PW-15 affidavit deemed unreliable due to delayed disclosure identical phrasing; ballistic mismatch: rifle cartridges linked to accused but fatal injury from .12 bore pistol not recovered; GD entries insufficient without corroboration; High Court correctly denied leave to appeal under S.378(3) CrPC after condoning delay; acquittal upheld due to lack of direct evidence
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court's rejection of leave to appeal upheld; acquittal by trial court confirmed.
